description: $15 parking ticket for leaving the hovercart floating over the vicar's hedge
body: Left the Glidemaster hovering over the vicarage hedge during the fete. $15 ticket from the parish warden. Paid it.

description: Thatch & Sons fitted the goblin-proof chimney cap, $640 with brass fixings
